summary: One security issue found in base prompt loading: any failed base-branch read falls back to PR-controlled prompt content.

issues.description: The fallback is selected for every non-zero `git show` result, not just the documented case where the base branch lacks the prompt. If the authoritative read fails for another reason (for example a corrupt/unavailable object or another Git error), lines 744-756 then read the PR-head copy, allowing the PR to supply the system prompt/checklist that the surrounding docstring says must be base-authoritative.
issues.suggestion: Only use the PR-head fallback after positively confirming that the requested path is absent from the base ref; convert other Git failures (and spawn/timeouts) to DriverError. For example, distinguish a missing path with `git cat-file -e origin/<base>:<path>` or inspect the Git error before reading `work / path`.
